comparison.objective: Install four handed-thread propellers on a quadcopter, not adjust and lock a stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Select thread direction, engage each hub, and screw it tight.
comparison.success_condition: All four hubs are tight on their motor bells with correct handedness and released.
comparison.reason: Threaded fastening is shared, but there is no calibrated setting to preserve, jam-nut countertorque, or post-lock motion verification.
